message: Enjoy your delicious Chicken and Rice Bowl with a refreshing Salad!
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs
2 cups of uncooked white or brown rice
4 cups of water or chicken broth
2 cups of mixed greens (lettuce, arugula, spinach)
1/4 cup of red onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Rinse the chicken and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the chicken in the oven for 25-30 minutes or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the rice according to package instructions using 4 cups of water or chicken broth.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for a few minutes before slicing it into thin strips.
To serve, place a scoop of cooked rice on a plate, top with sliced chicken, and add the salad on top.
Drizzle with salad dressing and olive oil if desired. Serve immediately and enjoy!
